_about: The Events page at /chicago/events/ (engine/events_page.py). 'file' is the page's listing, written daily by fetch_happening.py next to the page; 'units' is the map's file the neighborhood filter and card outline come from. 'words' are the page's own text; the engine names no city or source. 'shows' (November 15, 2026) adds the big venues' concerts, games and shows from the Venues listing (docs/<city>/venues/shows.json) with a switch at the top; its title, intro, desc and card replace the words'.

words.title: What’s on in Chicago
words.intro: Every Chicago Public Library program and every Chicago Park District event, for the next 30 days.
words.listing: A listing, not a guide: the facts and a link to the source, nothing else.
words.desc: What’s on in Chicago today, this weekend and this week: Chicago Public Library programs and Chicago Park District events, with free events marked.
words.card: Today, this weekend, the next 30 days
words.source: Events from the Chicago Public Library and the Chicago Park District, via the City of Chicago Data Portal (terms of use).

shows.title: What’s on in Chicago
shows.intro: Concerts, games and shows at Chicago’s big venues, plus every Chicago Public Library program and every Chicago Park District event, for the next 30 days.
shows.desc: What’s on in Chicago today, this weekend and this week: concerts, games and shows at the big venues, Chicago Public Library programs and Park District events.
shows.card: Big venues, community events, the next 30 days
shows.source: Shows at the big venues from Ticketmaster.
